text: Output is structured as a naming review with tiers such as Must Rename and Consider Renaming
Each finding is given as a current-to-proposed pair with a reason
Explicitly maps code names onto the business vocabulary (booking, stay, guest, check-in, check-out, folio balance) rather than inventing a third vocabulary
Flags FLAG_1 and FLAG_2 as meaningless, mapping them to the real domain events, early departure and no-show
Flags the abbreviations resId, startDt, endDt, uid, and tblVersion as failing understandability for no real concision gain
Flags user as the wrong domain term where the business says guest
Flags Record and tblVersion as leaking persistence vocabulary into the domain model
Checks consistency across the set, so the renamed functions and the renamed type use the same terms
